fixes.explanation: Not quite, baker. Nobody in this scene is waiting on a calendar. The LORD says, "I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out." (Genesis 18:21). He says He will go and look for Himself. That's a plan to check, not a plan to wait.

problems.problem: The dentist joke compares putting off a visit with the LORD saying He will go down and see. The actions do not match, so the comparison fails the joke logic test.
